title: Avro Lancaster LM619
memorial_details: Rectangular, brass plaque mounted onto a varnished wood backboard shaped like a cut-odd propeller, all attached to the trunk of a tree. Dedication is incised in black, upper-case letters.
inscription: 15TH JANUARY 1945/ LANCASTER LM619 (UNIT 1668 HCU)/ CRASHED AT THIS PLACE 20:30 HRS/ (names)
superseded_note: Thin IWM stub (IWM 100046) for the same memorial as westborough-lm619. The canonical record is westborough-lm619, which has full crew detail, narrative, photos, and extensive sourcing. Recommend deprecating this record.
